title: Planet Tweaks V3.2.1 NOVA TITAN - Jump-Shoot Lockout Purge, Mouse Calibration Studio, Random Apps Debloater & Discord Rich Presence
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.2.1 NOVA TITAN: (1) Fortnite Jump-Shoot Lockout Purge: Strips Windows Accidental Activation Prevention (AAP) lockout and tunes mouclass queue buffers so holding Space or WASD never blocks shooting in Fortnite or GeForce NOW. (2) Dedicated Mouse Calibration Studio: Integrated into Random hub with 1:1 MarkC raw curves and live click response diagnostics. (3) Dedicated Random Apps Debloater: Deep scan and 1-click uninstaller for pre-installed Windows bloatware packages. (4) Random Tweaks 10-per-Page Pagination: Fast, fluid paginated navigation with direct page count indicators. (5) Discord Rich Presence: Native IPC pipe integration showing live optimization status on Discord profiles. (6) Strict Zero-Mojibake Mandate: 100% clean UTF-8 encoding across all views and cloud endpoints.
